descriptions.before: GenerationService is a service that allows developers to generate 3D objects from text prompts utilizing Roblox's Cube 3D foundation model.
descriptions.after: Service that allows developers to generate 3D objects from text prompts.

descriptions.before: Starts the generation of a new 3D mesh from a text prompt and returns unique IDs used to track and retrieve the result. After the generation is complete, use LoadGeneratedMeshAsync() to load and display the generated mesh.
descriptions.after: Starts the generation of a new 3D mesh from a text prompt and returns unique IDs used to track and retrieve the result.

descriptions.before: Additional generation options. Currently, no options are supported.
descriptions.after:
A dictionary for additional generation options to influence the result. The following key is supported:
  • SuggestedSize — Optional Vector3 representing a size guide for the generated asset. The service will attempt to create a model with a size and proportion similar to the provided Vector3. This does not guarantee the final output size.

descriptions.before: A callback function triggered with intermediate generation results. Useful for retrieving early mesh versions (e.g. before textures are applied).
descriptions.after: A callback function triggered with intermediate generation results. Useful for retrieving early mesh versions before textures are applied.

descriptions.before:
A tuple of generation ID and context ID.
  • Generation ID: A unique ID returned for each invocation of GenerateMeshAsync().
  • Context ID: Not currently used.
descriptions.after: A tuple of the generation ID (a unique ID returned for each invocation of GenerateMeshAsync()) and context ID (not currently used).

descriptions.before: Retrieves and loads a mesh generated by GenerationService:GenerateMeshAsync() using the provided generationId. The mesh is returned as a MeshPart with EditableMesh content.
descriptions.after: Retrieves and loads a mesh generated by GenerationService:GenerateMeshAsync() using the provided generationId.

descriptions.before: The generated mesh, returned as a MeshPart containing an EditableMesh.
descriptions.after: The generated asset, returned as a Model with a single MeshPart containing an EditableMesh.
